product.short_description: Transform your space with our customizable recessed LED extrusion kit, perfect for dynamic entertainment, feature lighting, and modern residential projects. This complete set features a slim, shallow profile for a minimalist architectural look, complete with channel, lens, and secure spring-clip mounting accessories. Simply add your choice of LED tape for a seamless, professional-grade lighting integration.
